trap.label: inferir x copiar
trap.wrong: The author says that closed boxes are bad.
trap.right: The author implies that closed boxes show custom.
trap.why: Inferir ≠ copiar. Em português dizemos “o autor diz”; em inglês, use implies/suggests para ideias não ditas explicitamente.

mcq.q: What can be ___ from the text? (not stated)

fix.wrong: The author imply that custom matters.
fix.right: The author implies that custom matters.

rewrite.prompt: 3ª pessoa: “The author implies custom matters.” → negativa
rewrite.answer: The author does not imply that custom matters.
